stories.title: TTL Index Creation and Enforcement
stories.description: Implement MongoDB TTL index on expires_at field for automatic lock expiration. Ensure index creation is idempotent and validated at service startup.

stories.title: Stale Lock Recovery Logic
stories.description: Implement logic to detect and safely reclaim expired locks during acquisition attempts, ensuring atomic takeover only when TTL has passed and preventing split-brain scenarios.

stories.title: Admin Override and Forced Unlock Capability
stories.description: Provide a secure override mechanism to forcibly release or reassign locks in exceptional cases, with strict audit logging and authorization checks.

stories.title: Concurrent Acquisition Stress Tests
stories.description: Create tests simulating high-concurrency lock acquisition attempts to validate atomicity, race condition handling, and correctness under contention.
